assumptions.buffered_policy: 28-day observed-sales mean + 1.28 * trailing daily population std * sqrt(lead+review days)
assumptions.starting_inventory: historical opening stock on evaluation start; same for both policies
assumptions.incoming_orders: new simulated orders only; historical supplier receipts and prior POs excluded
assumptions.orders: placed at end of review day; arrivals at start of day after fixed lead

limitations: Observed historical sales are stockout-censored: simulated fill rates are NOT true customer service levels.
This is a retrospective moving-average inventory-policy replay, NOT a LightGBM-driven policy evaluation.
No historical receipts, existing purchase orders at origin, perishability, or lead-time uncertainty are modeled.
Holding costs assume an illustrative 20% annual rate; they are not measured operating costs.
The same historical period has been examined during forecasting; this is a diagnostic replay, not a newly untouched holdout.
